cases.reply:
The build dies at the COPY on Dockerfile:8: the runner key `id_ed25519` is not in the build context. That's the ignore rules doing their job, not a regression — `.dockerignore` excludes `**/id_*`, and rightly so, since baking a private key into image layers would leak it to everyone who can pull the image.

The fix is to stop copying the key and mount it as a BuildKit secret for the clone step:

```dockerfile
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=deploy_key \
    ssh-keyscan github.com >> /root/.ssh/known_hosts && \
    GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i /run/secrets/deploy_key" \
    git clone git@github.com:acme/private-modules.git /go/pkg/mod/acme
```

CI already exports `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1` (ci.yml:32), so only the Dockerfile and the workflow's secret input would change. Want me to rewrite it that way?
